answer: A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 15 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a kernel bet on surviving 93 epochs of grading, and every cedar settlement recomputes the ridge schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 93 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 14 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
